model_annotation: The plot illustrates how the metric labeled “Missing Step” varies across a sequence of x-values for two conditions, “w.o. extension” and “extension.” The x-axis has no explicit label and uses a linear numeric scale with tick marks at integers from 0 to 4 (interval 1), with no units shown. The y-axis is labeled “Missing Step,” shown on a linear scale with labeled ticks at approximately 0.840, 0.845, 0.850, 0.855, and 0.860 (regular interval 0.005), spanning roughly from about 0.838 up to about 0.862. The “w.o. extension” series is drawn as a blue dashed line with circular markers; it decreases from about 0.861 at x=0 to about 0.849 at x=1, about 0.843 at x=2, about 0.839 at x=3, and ends near 0.838 at x=4. The “extension” series is drawn as an orange solid line with upward-pointing triangle markers; it decreases from about 0.862 at x=0 to about 0.851 at x=1, about 0.847 at x=2, about 0.843 at x=3, and ends near 0.842 at x=4.
